info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Funds Confirmation API
info.description: The Funds Confirmation API enables users to verify the availability of funds for international scheduled payments. This API plays a critical role in the open banking ecosystem by providing payment initiation service providers (PISPs) with the ability to ensure that sufficient funds exist before proceeding with payment actions. It streamlines the payment process for consumers and businesses by enhancing certainty and reducing the likelihood of payment failures due to insufficient funds. Typical consumers include financial institutions and third-party payment services looking to enhance their payment workflows.

get.summary: Retrieve funds confirmation for an international scheduled payment consent.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to check the funds availability for the specified international scheduled payment consent identified by its unique reference. It ensures that the necessary funds are present before proceeding with further transaction steps.
